assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Battery is swollen, punctured, leaking, or has damaged or exposed leads.
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; check battery condition and lead insulation — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Charging causes abnormal heating, smoke, odor, or visible damage to the unit.
defects.spec_ref: Electronics block b1 (Battery and power management) / BOM e5 (Single-cell LiPo charger IC, TP4054)
defects.check_method: Functional charging test; monitor for abnormal heat, smoke, odor, or damage — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Accessible shell edges or seams have sharp burrs that could cut the user.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell)
defects.check_method: Visual and careful touch inspection of accessible edges and seams — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Top and bottom shells do not mate correctly, or the split-line step exceeds the specified limit.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: Split-line step ≤ 0.1 mm
defects.check_method: Assemble shells and measure the split-line step with a feeler gauge — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Shell mating faces or boss pilots are visibly out of tolerance, causing poor fit or screw assembly issues.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: Shell mating faces ±0.1 mm / Tolerance: Boss pilot Ø2.2 +0.05/0 mm
defects.check_method: Measure mating faces and boss pilots with suitable gauges — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Unit fails to power on, has intermittent operation, or heart-rate or motion sensing does not respond during the functional check.
defects.spec_ref: Electronics block b1 (Battery and power management) / Electronics block b3 (Optical heart-rate sensing) / Electronics block b4 (Motion sensing)
defects.check_method: Power-on and basic heart-rate and motion functional test — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: BLE function is absent or repeatedly disconnects during the functional check.
defects.spec_ref: Electronics block b2 (BLE MCU and antenna)
defects.check_method: Pair with a test device and verify connection and data exchange — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Charging contacts are missing, damaged, misaligned, or fail to make reliable electrical contact.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e9 (Charging contacts) / Electronics block b5 (Charging contacts)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection and charging-contact continuity or charging test — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Shells or strap have scratches, sink marks, blemishes, or finish color visibly different from the approved appearance sample.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Part p5 (Strap)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under D65 light at 50 cm; compare color with approved sample — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
